steps.what: Select course Web site content and establish the current teaching information
Develop and maintain course pages, links and navigation
Check student access, links and information before publishing course pages

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} course-page templates and reusable navigation. The teacher supplies current content and checks student-view access before publishing; no model creates teaching facts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Similar course pages can still be reconstructed manually each term.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing course systems offer reusable page structures.
tasks.still_hard: A copied page may retain an old deadline or inaccessible resource.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what students need and whether instructions are clear.
tasks.altitude: Less page construction, with content and publication responsibility unchanged.

reach.learn: Accessible course structure and student-view checks

evidence.claim: Native reusable course pages can reduce repeated construction; the proposed effort estimate is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is course website maintenance, excluding creation of the teaching materials linked from it.
Teacher produces course title, current deadlines, resource links, module order and visibility choices in s1 at full 40 hours. Missing metadata and transfer checks remain within s2's 20 hours.
No automatic source feed is assumed. Missing or stale fields require manual correction before publication.
Test existing course-copy and page-template functions before custom code. Existing delivery runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Does reuse reduce page construction after all old dates and permissions are checked?

already_counted.description: Supply current content and publication metadata
Adapt reused pages and verify transferred fields

incremental.description: Maintain reusable page structure and resolve template issues

approvals.approved_version: Exact course page version, dates, links, visibility and access rules; edits void publication approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R80 gross20 minus4 upkeep =16 net E1. High requires manual page rebuilding; low allows already reused pages or extensive course changes.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collaborate with business community members on programs and student learning opportunities

tasks.design: Retain direct relationship work with business partners. Existing {DOCS} program information may inform discussion, without assuming that agreement can be automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Opportunities depend on partner trust and educational fit.
tasks.enabler_now: No new software is necessary for collaboration.
tasks.still_hard: Aligning student learning, business capacity and program expectations.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust and negotiate useful learning opportunities.
tasks.altitude: Partnership responsibilities and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Business partnership collaboration is retained as personal work; no administrative baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is partner collaboration and learning-opportunity agreement, excluding later placement administration.
Participants supply needs and constraints in the fully retained discussion; no structured partner profile is required.
Existing tools remain unchanged and upkeep is zero.
research_questions: Which partner constraints most often prevent useful student opportunities?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; relationship work and agreement remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review committee material on institutional policies and departmental or academic issues
Serve on committees through discussion, challenge and collective decisions

tasks.design: Retain reading of original committee papers in {DOCS} and collective deliberation. No automatic summary is assumed to substitute for understanding the proposal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Committee choices require context and accountable participation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document access supports the work.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving trade-offs among academic and institutional interests.
tasks.human_edge: Question assumptions and represent informed views.

evidence.claim: Reading and deliberation remain fully counted in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is the teacher's committee participation, not secretariat minutes or paper production.
Committee secretary supplies original papers through the existing process; no new structured intake is required.
No system change or incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which evidence is needed before members can assess a proposal?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 upkeep0 net0; informed committee participation remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select materials and supplies such as textbooks for the course
Obtain selected materials through the approved ordering channel

tasks.design: Use native {PROCUREMENT} catalogue requests for selected materials, with reusable course delivery details. The teacher retains educational selection and checks the request; existing budget approval and supplier ordering stay with their owners.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ordering can repeat item and delivery details across requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured catalogue requests can reuse approved item information.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the right edition, access rights and educational fit.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate whether materials support the course.
tasks.altitude: Less ordering entry, with material selection unchanged.

reach.learn: Edition identifiers, licences and purchasing rules

evidence.claim: Catalogue requests can reduce repeated entry while retaining item and delivery checks; savings are a scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher selection and internal request, excluding procurement approval, payment and supplier fulfilment.

Teacher produces title, edition or item identifier, quantity, required date and course code during s1's full70 hours. Request-specific delivery confirmation and missing fields remain in s2's 15 hours.
Purchasing coordinator maintains existing catalogue and authorised delivery locations. Additional catalogue correction work is counted below; missing items revert to manual request.
Test native catalogue and saved request configuration first.
research_questions: Does native catalogue reuse reduce request time after edition and licence checks?

already_counted.description: Request capture, edition and delivery check

incremental.description: Resolve catalogue exceptions and update saved details

approvals.approved_version: Exact item identifiers, editions, quantities, delivery location and date of the internal request; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R85 gross15 minus3 upkeep =12 net E1. High needs recurring catalogue orders; low covers mostly unique or already streamlined requests.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated course-page construction and material ordering, while retaining educational and partnership decisions.
reach: Work with course support and purchasing on reusable structures
role.ambitious_version: A teacher who maintains clear course information with less repeated entry.
